      "pseudocode": "class TFTDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):\n    def __init__(self, data_path, config, mode='train'):\n        raw_data = load_data(data_path)  # 加载CSV/pickle\n        processed = preprocess(raw_data, config)  # 归一化、编码\n        windows = create_windows(processed, config.lookback, config.forecast_horizon)\n        # mode: 'train'/'val'/'test' -> 按时间序列划分\n        self.static_covariates = windows['static']       # (N, num_static_features)\n        self.past_observed = windows['past_observed']     # (N, k, num_past_features)\n        self.known_future = windows['known_future']        # (N, τmax, num_future_features)\n        self.past_targets = windows['past_targets']        # (N, k, 1)\n        self.future_targets = windows['future_targets']    # (N, τmax, 1)\n        self.categorical_indices = processed['categorical_indices']\n        self.continuous_indices = processed['continuous_indices']\n        self.scalers = processed['scalers']\n    \n    def __len__(self):\n        return len(self.static_covariates)\n    \n    def __getitem__(self, idx):\n        return {\n            'static': self.static_covariates[idx],         # (num_static_features,)\n            'past_inputs': self.past_observed[idx],        # (k, num_past_features)\n            'future_inputs': self.known_future[idx],       # (τmax, num_future_features)\n            'past_targets': self.past_targets[idx],        # (k, 1)\n            'future_targets': self.future_targets[idx]     # (τmax, 1)\n        }\n\ndef load_data(data_path):\n    # 读取数据文件(CSV/PKL)\n    # 返回raw_data dict: {features, targets, static, timestamps, entity_ids}\n    pass\n\ndef preprocess(raw_data, config):\n    # 1. 分离静态/过去/未来特征列\n    # 2. 对连续特征做标准化(StandardScaler)\n    # 3. 对分类特征做LabelEncoder/Embedding索引映射\n    # 4. 保存scalers用于反归一化\n    # 返回processed dict\n    pass\n\ndef create_windows(data, lookback, forecast_horizon):\n    # 对每个实体的时序数据创建滑动窗口\n    # 每个样本: past=[t-k, t], future=[t+1, t+τmax]\n    # 返回windows dict\n    pass"

    "models/lstm.py": {
      "description": "实现TFT的基础构件模块：Gated Linear Units (GLU)、Gated Residual Network (GRN)、LSTM Encoder-Decoder用于局部时间建模（Locality Enhancement）、Static Enrichment层。GRN/GLU是TFT的门控机制核心，LSTM处理过去/未来输入序列。",
      "class": "GatedLinearUnit, GatedResidualNetwork, Lstm, StaticEnrichment",
      "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
      "methods": [
        "GatedLinearUnit.__init__(self, input_size, output_size, dropout_rate)",
        "GatedLinearUnit.forward(self, x) -> Tensor",
        "GatedResidualNetwork.__init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, output_size, dropout_rate, context_size=None)",
        "GatedResidualNetwork.forward(self, x, context=None) -> Tensor",
        "Lstm.__init__(self, d_model, num_layers, dropout_rate)",
        "Lstm.forward(self, past_inputs, future_inputs, context_cc=None, context_ch=None) -> (Tensor, Tensor)",
        "StaticEnrichment.__init__(self, d_model, hidden_size, dropout_rate)",
        "StaticEnrichment.forward(self, x, context_ce) -> Tensor"
      ],
      "functions": [],
      "pseudocode": "# === Gated Linear Unit (GLU) ===\nclass GatedLinearUnit(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, input_size, output_size, dropout_rate):\n        self.W4 = nn.Linear(input_size, output_size)  # main projection\n        self.W3 = nn.Linear(input_size, output_size)  # gate projection\n        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)\n    \n    def forward(self, x):\n        x = self.dropout(x)\n        return self.W4(x) * torch.sigmoid(self.W3(x))\n\n# === Gated Residual Network (GRN) ===\n# GRN(x, c) = LayerNorm(GLU(ELU(W2(ELU(W1(x) + Wc(c))))) + W_skip(x))\nclass GatedResidualNetwork(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, output_size, dropout_rate, context_size=None):\n        self.W1 = nn.Linear(input_size, hidden_size)\n        self.Wc = nn.Linear(context_size, hidden_size) if context_size else None\n        self.W2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)\n        self.glu = GatedLinearUnit(hidden_size, output_size, dropout_rate)\n        self.W_skip = nn.Linear(input_size, output_size) if input_size != output_size else nn.Identity()\n        self.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(output_size)\n    \n    def forward(self, x, context=None):\n        hidden = F.elu(self.W1(x))\n        if self.Wc is not None and context is not None:\n            hidden = hidden + self.Wc(context)  # context broadcasting\n        hidden = F.elu(self.W2(hidden))\n        output = self.glu(hidden) + self.W_skip(x)\n        return self.layer_norm(output)\n\n# === LSTM Encoder-Decoder ===\n# 处理past (ξ̃_t-k:t) 和future (ξ̃_t+1:t+τmax)\n# cc初始化cell state, ch初始化hidden state (仅encoder第一层)\n# 输出拼接encoder+decoder hidden states\nclass Lstm(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_model, num_layers, dropout_rate):\n        self.encoder_lstm = nn.LSTM(d_model, d_model, num_layers, batch_first=True, dropout=dropout_rate if num_layers>1 else 0)\n        self.decoder_lstm = nn.LSTM(d_model, d_model, num_layers, batch_first=True, dropout=dropout_rate if num_layers>1 else 0)\n        self.glu = GatedLinearUnit(d_model, d_model, dropout_rate)  # gated skip\n    \n    def forward(self, past_inputs, future_inputs, context_cc=None, context_ch=None):\n        # past_inputs: (B, k, d_model), future_inputs: (B, τmax, d_model)\n        # context_cc, context_ch: (B, d_model) or None\n        B = past_inputs.size(0)\n        # 初始化encoder状态\n        if context_ch is not None and context_cc is not None:\n            h0 = context_ch.unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.num_layers, 1, 1)  # (L, B, d)\n            c0 = context_cc.unsqueeze(0).repeat(self.num_layers, 1, 1)  # (L, B, d)\n        else:\n            h0, c0 = None, None\n        # Encoder: process past\n        encoder_out, (h_n, c_n) = self.encoder_lstm(past_inputs, (h0, c0))  # (B, k, d)\n        # Decoder: process future with encoder final state\n        decoder_out, _ = self.decoder_lstm(future_inputs, (h_n, c_n))  # (B, τmax, d)\n        # Concatenate and apply gated skip\n        lstm_out = torch.cat([encoder_out, decoder_out], dim=1)  # (B, k+τmax, d)\n        lstm_input = torch.cat([past_inputs, future_inputs], dim=1)  # (B, k+τmax, d)\n        result = lstm_out + self.glu(lstm_out)  # gated residual\n        return result  # (B, k+τmax, d_model)\n\n# === Static Enrichment Layer ===\nclass StaticEnrichment(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_model, hidden_size, dropout_rate):\n        self.grn = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate, context_size=d_model)\n    \n    def forward(self, x, context_ce):\n        # x: (B, k+τmax, d_model), context_ce: (B, d_model)\n        # broadcast context_ce across time\n        context_expanded = context_ce.unsqueeze(1).expand_as(x)  # (B, k+τmax, d)\n        return self.grn(x, context_expanded)"
    },

    "models/transformer.py": {
      "description": "实现TFT核心架构：Interpretable Multi-Head Attention (可解释多头注意力，共享value权重并取平均)、Variable Selection Network (样本依赖的变量选择)、Static Covariate Encoder (生成cs/ce/cc/ch上下文向量)、以及完整TFT模型类Transformer。Transformer类整合LSTM encoder-decoder、静态增强层、注意力层、前馈层和分位数输出层。",
      "class": "InterpretableMultiHeadAttention, VariableSelectionNetwork, StaticCovariateEncoder, Transformer",
      "parent_class": "torch.nn.Module",
      "methods": [
        "InterpretableMultiHeadAttention.__init__(self, d_model, num_heads, dropout_rate)",
        "InterpretableMultiHeadAttention.forward(self, Q, K, V, mask=None) -> (Tensor, Tensor)",
        "VariableSelectionNetwork.__init__(self, d_model, num_vars, hidden_size, dropout_rate, context_size=None)",
        "VariableSelectionNetwork.forward(self, embeddings, context=None) -> (Tensor, Tensor)",
        "StaticCovariateEncoder.__init__(self, d_model, hidden_size, dropout_rate)",
        "StaticCovariateEncoder.forward(self, static_inputs) -> (Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor)",
        "Transformer.__init__(self, config)",
        "Transformer.forward(self, static_inputs, past_inputs, future_inputs, past_targets=None) -> dict",
        "Transformer._embed_inputs(self, static_inputs, past_inputs, future_inputs) -> tuple",
        "Transformer._generate_causal_mask(self, total_len) -> Tensor"
      ],
      "functions": [],
      "pseudocode": "# === Interpretable Multi-Head Attention ===\n# 与标准MHA不同: 共享value投影WV, 各头输出取平均\n# H̃ = (1/H) * Σ_h A_h(Q*WQ_h, K*WK_h) * V * WV\n# Output = H̃ * WH\nclass InterpretableMultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_model, num_heads, dropout_rate):\n        self.H = num_heads\n        self.d_attn = d_model // num_heads\n        # 每个头有独立的query/key投影\n        self.WQ = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(d_model, self.d_attn) for _ in range(num_heads)])\n        self.WK = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(d_model, self.d_attn) for _ in range(num_heads)])\n        # Value投影跨所有头共享\n        self.WV = nn.Linear(d_model, self.d_attn)\n        # 输出投影\n        self.WH = nn.Linear(self.d_attn, d_model)\n        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_rate)\n        self.attention_weights = None  # 保存用于可解释性\n    \n    def forward(self, Q, K, V, mask=None):\n        # Q,K,V: (B, T, d_model), mask: (B, T, T) or (T, T)\n        head_outputs = []\n        all_attn_weights = []\n        for h in range(self.H):\n            q_h = self.WQ[h](Q)  # (B, T, d_attn)\n            k_h = self.WK[h](K)  # (B, T, d_attn)\n            scores = torch.matmul(q_h, k_h.transpose(-2,-1)) / math.sqrt(self.d_attn)\n            if mask is not None:\n                scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float('-inf'))\n            attn = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)  # (B, T, T)\n            all_attn_weights.append(attn)\n            v_h = self.WV(V)  # (B, T, d_attn) — 共享value\n            head_outputs.append(torch.matmul(attn, v_h))  # (B, T, d_attn)\n        # 取平均: H̃ = (1/H) * Σ head_outputs\n        H_tilde = torch.stack(head_outputs, dim=0).mean(dim=0)  # (B, T, d_attn)\n        output = self.WH(H_tilde)  # (B, T, d_model)\n        output = self.dropout(output)\n        self.attention_weights = torch.stack(all_attn_weights, dim=0)  # (H, B, T, T)\n        return output, self.attention_weights\n\n# === Variable Selection Network ===\n# 样本依赖变量选择: 对每个变量计算重要性权重，加权求和\n# selected = Σ_i softmax(GRN_stack)[i] * GRN_vi(embedding_i)\nclass VariableSelectionNetwork(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_model, num_vars, hidden_size, dropout_rate, context_size=None):\n        self.num_vars = num_vars\n        # 变量权重GRN: 输入flatten后变量, 输出num_vars权重\n        self.weight_grn = GatedResidualNetwork(\n            num_vars * d_model, hidden_size, num_vars, dropout_rate, context_size)\n        # 每个变量的特征变换GRN\n        self.feature_grns = nn.ModuleList([\n            GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate, context_size)\n            for _ in range(num_vars)])\n    \n    def forward(self, embeddings, context=None):\n        # embeddings: list of num_vars tensors, each (B, T, d_model)\n        # context: (B, d_model) or (B, T, d_model) or None\n        # 1. 计算变量权重\n        flattened = torch.cat(embeddings, dim=-1)  # (B, T, num_vars*d_model)\n        if context is not None and context.dim() == 2:\n            ctx = context.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, flattened.size(1), -1)\n        else:\n            ctx = context\n        var_weights = F.softmax(self.weight_grn(flattened, ctx), dim=-1)  # (B, T, num_vars)\n        # 2. 特征变换\n        transformed = [grn(emb, ctx) for grn, emb in zip(self.feature_grns, embeddings)]\n        # 3. 加权求和\n        selected = sum(var_weights[..., i:i+1] * transformed[i] for i in range(self.num_vars))\n        return selected, var_weights  # selected: (B, T, d_model), weights: (B, T, num_vars)\n\n# === Static Covariate Encoder ===\n# 生成四个上下文向量: cs(变量选择), ce(静态增强), cc(LSTM cell), ch(LSTM hidden)\nclass StaticCovariateEncoder(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, d_model, hidden_size, dropout_rate):\n        self.gs = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate)  # cs\n        self.ge = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate)  # ce\n        self.gc = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate)  # cc\n        self.gh = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout_rate)  # ch\n    \n    def forward(self, static_inputs):\n        # static_inputs: (B, d_model) — 已经过embedding/transform的静态特征\n        cs = self.gs(static_inputs)  # (B, d_model)\n        ce = self.ge(static_inputs)  # (B, d_model)\n        cc = self.gc(static_inputs)  # (B, d_model)\n        ch = self.gh(static_inputs)  # (B, d_model)\n        return cs, ce, cc, ch\n\n# === TFT完整模型 (类名Transformer) ===\nclass Transformer(nn.Module):\n    def __init__(self, config):\n        d_model = config.model.d_model\n        num_heads = config.model.num_attention_heads\n        dropout = config.model.dropout_rate\n        quantiles = config.model.quantiles\n        \n        # 1. 输入嵌入层\n        self.past_embedding = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(1, d_model) for _ in range(num_past_features)])\n        self.future_embedding = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(1, d_model) for _ in range(num_future_features)])\n        self.static_embedding = nn.Linear(num_static_features, d_model)\n        # 分类变量使用nn.Embedding\n        \n        # 2. Static Covariate Encoder\n        self.static_encoder = StaticCovariateEncoder(d_model, hidden_size, dropout)\n        \n        # 3. Variable Selection Networks\n        self.vsn_static = VariableSelectionNetwork(d_model, num_static_features, hidden_size, dropout)\n        self.vsn_past = VariableSelectionNetwork(d_model, num_past_features, hidden_size, dropout, context_size=d_model)\n        self.vsn_future = VariableSelectionNetwork(d_model, num_future_features, hidden_size, dropout, context_size=d_model)\n        \n        # 4. LSTM Encoder-Decoder\n        self.lstm = Lstm(d_model, num_lstm_layers, dropout)\n        \n        # 5. Static Enrichment\n        self.static_enrichment = StaticEnrichment(d_model, hidden_size, dropout)\n        \n        # 6. Interpretable Multi-Head Attention\n        self.attention = InterpretableMultiHeadAttention(d_model, num_heads, dropout)\n        self.attn_glu = GatedLinearUnit(d_model, d_model, dropout)  # gated skip\n        \n        # 7. Position-wise Feedforward GRN\n        self.ff_grn = GatedResidualNetwork(d_model, hidden_size, d_model, dropout)\n        self.ff_glu = GatedLinearUnit(d_model, d_model, dropout)  # gated skip\n        \n        # 8. Quantile Output Layer: ŷ(q,t,τ) = Wq * ψ̃(t,τ) + bq\n        self.quantile_heads = nn.ModuleList([\n            nn.Linear(d_model, 1) for _ in range(len(quantiles))])\n        self.quantiles = quantiles\n    \n    def forward(self, static_inputs, past_inputs, future_inputs, past_targets=None):\n        B, k, _ = past_inputs.shape\n        τ = future_inputs.shape[1]\n        \n        # Step 1: Embed inputs\n        static_emb = self._embed_static(static_inputs)  # list of m_s tensors (B, d_model)\n        past_embs = self._embed_past(past_inputs)       # list of m_z tensors (B, k, d_model)\n        future_embs = self._embed_future(future_inputs)  # list of m_x tensors (B, τ, d_model)\n        \n        # Step 2: Static Covariate Encoding\n        static_concat = torch.cat(static_emb, dim=-1)  # (B, m_s*d_model)\n        static_rep = self.static_embedding(static_concat)  # (B, d_model)\n        cs, ce, cc, ch = self.static_encoder(static_rep)\n        \n        # Step 3: Variable Selection\n        selected_static, vs_static_w = self.vsn_static(static_emb)\n        selected_past, vs_past_w = self.vsn_past(past_embs, cs)   # (B, k, d_model)\n        selected_future, vs_future_w = self.vsn_future(future_embs, cs)  # (B, τ, d_model)\n        \n        # Step 4: LSTM Encoder-Decoder with gated skip\n        lstm_out = self.lstm(selected_past, selected_future, cc, ch)  # (B, k+τ, d_model)\n        \n        # Step 5: Static Enrichment\n        enriched = self.static_enrichment(lstm_out, ce)  # (B, k+τ, d_model)\n        \n        # Step 6: Interpretable Multi-Head Attention with causal mask\n        causal_mask = self._generate_causal_mask(k + τ)  # (k+τ, k+τ)\n        attn_out, attn_weights = self.attention(enriched, enriched, enriched, mask=causal_mask)\n        attn_result = enriched + self.attn_glu(attn_out)  # gated skip\n        \n        # Step 7: Position-wise Feedforward GRN with gated skip\n        ff_out = self.ff_grn(attn_result)  # (B, k+τ, d_model)\n        final = attn_result + self.ff_glu(ff_out)  # gated skip\n        \n        # Step 8: Take future positions only\n        future_out = final[:, k:, :]  # (B, τ, d_model)\n        \n
